cases.rationale: The second lookup found only a passage the first had already returned.

cases.label: no_opportunity

cases.label: no_opportunity
cases.rationale: Each task's second lookup found something new; passages repeat only across unrelated tasks.

cases.label: opportunity
cases.rationale: The second lookup added nothing, but the answer step also uses the rephrased query, so only the lookup is removable.

cases.label: unknown

cases.label: ambiguous
cases.rationale: The second lookup returned the same passages in another order; whether order matters to the answer step is not recorded.
